transcription.text: My name is Lori Hessler. My husband and I are the owners of Rawlings Heating in AC.
We started working with Oscar back in March. Very attentive in any website updates that
we need. And then forward to May, we got a Google denial for our business account and
he has been instrumental in working with Google to get our verification back up. It's been
a two month process. I cannot say enough about his communication and his updates that he
has given us along the way and his persistence at going to Google on a regular basis to allow
for our verification to finally be cleared. And I can't say enough about his worth ethic,
his communication with me via email or text message and even on his days off, really getting
us through this Google process. You have an amazing employee with Oscar and I look forward
to working with him in the future.
